title: TR-FRET bromodomain-histone peptide binding screen in 384-well plates
summary: A homogeneous HTRF-type competition assay: tagged bromodomain protein, biotinylated acetylated-H4 peptide and Eu cryptate / XL665 antibodies give a FRET signal that compounds can disrupt. Reported Z' of 0.87 at 0.25% DMSO. Mirrors the BRD4-style screen in the pipeline.

steps.text: Prepare assay buffer (HEPES pH 7.4, NaCl, BSA, Triton X-100).
Dispense compound and 10 nM GST-bromodomain protein into white 384-well plates; incubate 30 min at room temperature.
Add 100 nM biotinylated acetylated H4 peptide; incubate 30 min.
Add anti-GST-Eu cryptate donor and XL665 acceptor reagents (40 uL total volume); incubate 90 min.
Read time-resolved fluorescence: excite 337 nm, emission 615 nm and 665 nm.
Compute ratio inhibition; call hits above 70% inhibition at 50 uM and compute Z' from controls.

materials: GST-CBP bromodomain, biotin-H4 peptide, Eu-anti-GST, XL665-anti-GST
notes: Target is CBP bromodomain, not BRD4. Reader and dispenser are our catalog suggestions.
